Name: Furniture Machine
Author: zombifier
Description:
This framework mod allows furniture items to utilize machine rules (notably input-based rules).

Installation Instructions For Users:
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and extract the zip into the Mods folder inside the game folder.
[*]IMPORTANT NOTE: If you use Producer Framework Mod, also update it to the latest version! This mod doesn't rely on PFM, but PFM versions before 1.9.7 breaks it.
[*]RECOMMENDED: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32562]Stack More Things[/url]﻿ to stack your items to 9999 (furniture only stacks to 1 by default)
[/list]
See below for link to source and guide for modders.

[url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/FurnitureMachine]Source and Modder Guide
[/url]
